title: LA Craft Solo – Vermilion Najeon (Seated)
prompt:
Subject: ONE extremely large SuperBBW Korean woman in her mid-50s, black hair in a tall eonjeun-meori updo with mother-of-pearl tteoljam, natural face with a regal gaze.

Physique: Heavily oversized SuperBBW physique THE MOST EXTREME PHYSICALLY POSSIBLE — colossal soft belly resting in deep rolls over the thighs, overwhelmingly massive heavy bust, extremely wide hips filling the throne seat, enormous thick thighs, very broad soft arms, profound physical volume filling the frame.

Body Art: Full body najeon-chilgi body painting from neck to ankle, painted directly on bare skin, one continuous surface, not latex. Deep glossy vermilion lacquer with natural highlights, inlaid with iridescent mother-of-pearl ten longevity symbols — sun, clouds, cranes, pine, deer, turtles, waves. Pelvis, inner thighs, and both arms fully patterned. Authentic Korean Joseon style.

Pose: Seated on a carved wooden throne with body turned 30 degrees to the left, legs crossed at the knee, forearms on the armrests, torso upright and open. Full body head to toe visible.

Footwear: 8-inch vermilion lacquer platform Mary Jane stilettos with pearl buckles. Nails: extra long stiletto nails, vermilion with pearl tips.

Background & Lighting: Joseon throne hall with dancheong beams and an Irworobongdo screen, softly blurred. ONE woman only. Figure fills 90% of the frame, low camera angle, 85mm lens. Warm golden key with raking side light. Emphasis on the extremely large SuperBBW body volume. 2:3 vertical 8K portrait.
